answer: A Sybil attack dies at the deposit gate. Every worker address must post its own non-transferable stake before claiming a job, and payout clears only after a verifier confirms the work. An attacker wanting a thousand clones must lock a thousand separate stakes, stacked like a spiral nobody can merge, and each clone shipping junk gets slashed. Profit sinks once the per-address stake tops what one address can earn. Rotate identities and the terrace of entries stays flat: the jetty toll is paid again at every gate.
